entities.title: View schemas and their examples
entities.summary: Every view schema in Skills/ is a valid schema and its fictional example passes it.
criteria: Each of the nine schema.json files is a valid JSON Schema Draft 2020-12.
Each example.json validates against the schema.json beside it, passes the graph checks (unique IDs, relationship endpoints, use-case alternatives) and points its $schema at that schema.
entities.details: Nothing checks describe-actor's template.md and example.md, or the skill.md files: validate_diagrams.py does not walk its own folder.

entities.title: Knowledge schemas and their examples
entities.summary: Every knowledge schema is a valid schema, and every kind has a fictional example that passes it.
criteria: Each file in Knowledge/schemas, common.schema.json included, is a valid JSON Schema Draft 2020-12.
Each kind has examples/<kind>.json, which validates against its schema, has unique entity IDs and points its $schema at that schema.
entities.details: The examples are checked without a repository root, so the paths they mention are not required to exist.
